objective: Randomised pilot with 45,000 dormant accounts in three arms of 15,000
segment: Dormant account holders with salary signals (E2)
channels: SMS brandname, Zalo template message, push, email, Ensa; at most 3 touches per account
message: "Your account is ready. Let payday do the investing." Start from VND 500,000; no sign-up reward
guardrails: Control arm receives no offer; all terms on one screen; no conditional bonus
decision_point: Gate 1 (month 6): enrolment >= 1.5% to scale, < 1.0% to stop; >= 81% make 3 contributions in a row; >= 80% new money; projected net cost per new account above VND 10 million <= VND 1.6 million
